designationHistory.indexText: The Secretary of the Interior established Buffalo Lake National Wildlife Refuge by Secretarial Order 2843.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Buffalo Lake National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

USFWS, Buffalo Lake National Wildlife Refuge: Comprehensive Conservation Plan and Environmental Assessment (ServCat 43405): "Buffalo Lake NWR was established on November 17, 1959 under Secretarial Order #2843, using the authority of the Migratory Bird Conservation Act"

review.note: Draft sentence described Grulla NWR (1969). Buffalo Lake NWR: Secretarial Order 2843, Nov. 17, 1959 (CCP); the project had been transferred to Interior by EO 10787 in Nov. 1958.
